title: fix(lint)!: the remaining field indexes judge an object as served, and an object that declares no field keeps the list-view skip once extended (#30608)
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuV5cRafodM2YQHxeDkdiWJM)_

domain:spec#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVSM5tJd2UYk3Aa1MM

Fixes #30608

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` refuse shapes they accepted before, each a field an `objectExtensions` entry of the same artifact adds or re-declares, now judged on its served definition: a notify node's `recipients.emailField` naming an owner `email` field an extension re-declares as `text` is `notify-email-field-not-email` at `error`; a form open to anonymous intake whose section names an `image` / `file` field an extension adds, or an owner field an extension re-declares as one, is `public-form-file-field` at `error`; a `list` page leading `allowedVisualizations` with `gallery` over an owner `image` field an extension re-declares as `text` is `page/visualization-without-binding` at `error`; a `searchableFields` entry naming an owner text field an extension re-declares as `formula` is `searchable-field-unsearchable` at `error`; an autonumber field an extension adds whose format names a field the object lacks is `autonumber-references-unknown-field` at `error`, and a format naming an owner `required: true` field an extension re-declares without it is `autonumber-references-optional-field` at `warning`; a flow template `{{ record.F.sub }}` through an owner text field an extension re-declares as a lookup is `flow-template-lookup-traversal` at `warning`. The widening half: a form section, a notify email-field recipient, a flow template hole, a gallery or calendar binding, a `searchableFields` entry (an object's own set, a list view's narrowing, a react page's `<ListView searchableFields>`) or an autonumber format naming a field an `objectExtensions` entry adds is no longer refused as unknown, and a list view over an object that declares no field is no longer refused once an extension adds to it.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — measured at `2818af5b`: `git grep` of the twelve moved rule ids over `skills/` and `content/docs/` hits `public-form-file-field` (`content/docs/ui/forms.mdx:258`, `content/docs/ui/public-data-collection.mdx:55`, `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md:106`), `searchable-field-unknown` / `searchable-field-unsearchable` (`content/docs/data-modeling/schema-design.mdx:153,172`, `content/docs/ui/views.mdx:182-184`, `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:128,154`, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md:207-208`) and release pages only otherwise; none states a declared-only reading ("a file field", "a renamed / mistyped column"), so every sentence reads true. The patch round (`887e5623`) adds no rule id and changes no message.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：lint 里剩下的七个字段索引（表单布局、通知邮件字段收件人、公开表单文件字段、流程模板、列表页可视化绑定、可搜索字段、自动编号格式）都改读“注册表实际提供的对象”，即声明字段加上同一制品里 `objectExtensions` 加的字段；React 页的 `<ListView searchableFields>` 也读同一份；列表视图规则对“一个字段都没声明的对象”恢复不判。
- 为什么改：HotCRM 这类多包制品里，模块包给 app 包的对象加字段，运行时会提供这些字段，lint 却把引用它们报成“未知字段”；扩展重新声明的字段又按 owner 的旧定义判断，真正的问题被漏掉。
- 风险与回滚：这是收窄。扩展重新声明或新加的字段按它的定义判断，会拒以前放行的几种写法：通知收件字段被改成 text、公开表单上出现图片/文件字段、画廊页的图片字段被改成 text、可搜字段被改成 formula、扩展自带的自动编号格式引用不存在的字段（以上为错误），以及自动编号引用的必填字段被改成非必填、流程模板穿过被改成 lookup 的字段（以上为警告）。两个包在同一优先级写同一字段时不判定义；一个字段都没声明的对象照旧不判。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-searchable-fields.ts` 的 `indexServedSearchTargets`（名字从带并列的 served 对象取、并列字段的定义置空占位、不声明字段对象的 null）；`packages/lint/src/validate-page-visualization-bindings.ts` 的 skip 2 与 `tiedOnObject`；`packages/lint/src/object-graph.test.ts` 末尾的 `[#30608]` 一组。
- 两分钟验证：运行 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/object-graph.test.ts -t 30608`，预期 42 例全绿；其中 moved 表 14 行各自断言 main 视角（无扩展）的旧结论和现在的新结论。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One artifact, two legs (the union artifact and the per-package body, identical on every row): an app package declares `xs_deal` (`name`, plus the owner field a row names) and `xs_account`; a module package extends `xs_deal`.

| Site | Moved or kept | Pin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `validate-form-layout.ts` field-name set | moved to `objectsAsServed`; tie name kept (existence); an unextended object keeps its map-only read | added passes, refused without, `nowhere` byte-for-byte |
| `validate-notify-email-field-recipients.ts` `indexFieldTypes` | moved; a tied field is `null` (skipped); declares-nothing keeps its empty map | existence row; two moved rows; tie; declares-nothing |
| `validate-public-form-file-fields.ts` `indexFieldTypes` | moved, ties dropped; declares-nothing keeps its empty map | three moved rows; tie; declares-nothing |
| `validate-flow-template-paths.ts` field map | moved; a tied head is known with no type; root resolution and the provenance anchors stay on the declared object | existence row; two moved rows; tie |
| `validate-page-visualization-bindings.ts` derivation | moved, ties dropped, an object carrying a tie not reported on a miss; skip 2 asked of the declared object; own list views stay declared | two moved rows; tie; declares-nothing |
| `validate-searchable-fields.ts` | new `indexServedSearchTargets`: names read off the served objects with ties kept, then each tied field's meta blanked to a stub (so an object whose every served field is tied keeps a target and still refuses an unknown entry), declares-nothing kept `null`; `validateSearchableFields` reads it; `indexObjectSearchTargets` stays the declared primitive (docblock says why) | two existence rows; moved row; tie; declares-nothing; the all-tied corner on the object and the list view, both registration orders, with its unextended and single-writer controls |
| `validate-react-page-props.ts` `<ListView searchableFields>` | moved to `indexServedSearchTargets` (file surface amended by the seat) | existence row; the PR #30533 "still declared" pin flipped in place |
| `lint-autonumber-formats.ts` | walks and resolves the served fields, ties dropped (a tied reference is neither unknown nor optional); an object declaring no field is skipped | existence row; four moved rows; tie; declares-nothing |
| `validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` (item 2) | skip 2 asked of the declared graph: an object that declares no field stays `null` when extended | item-2 pin with and without the extension, plus the declared control; declares-nothing row |

### Every finding that moves, against `main`

Measured with `runAuthoringRules('validate', { normalized, parsed })` on `origin/main` `a8390207` and on `2818af5b`, union and per-package legs (identical on every case); 58 cases, every unlisted case unchanged (the no-extension controls and every `nowhere` control included). The last two rows were measured in the patch round on `a8390207` and `887e5623` (the rule sources of each, through `validateFlowTemplatePaths` / `validateFormLayout`, both legs identical).

| notify `emailField` naming an added `email` field (also on a tie) | `notify-email-field-unknown` error | nothing |
| notify `emailField` naming an added `text` field | `notify-email-field-unknown` error | `notify-email-field-not-email` error |
| notify `emailField` naming an owner `email` field re-declared `text` | nothing | **`notify-email-field-not-email` error** |

| gallery page, added `image` field (also on a tie) | `page/visualization-without-binding` error | nothing |
| gallery page, owner `image` field re-declared `text` | nothing | **`page/visualization-without-binding` error** |
| `searchableFields` (object's own, list view's) naming an added field (also on a tie) | `searchable-field-unknown` error | nothing |
| object `searchableFields` naming an owner `text` field re-declared `formula` | nothing | **`searchable-field-unsearchable` error** |
| autonumber `{region}{000}`, added `required` field (also on a tie) | `autonumber-references-unknown-field` error | nothing |
| autonumber `{region}{000}`, added optional field | `autonumber-references-unknown-field` error | `autonumber-references-optional-field` warning |
| autonumber `{plan}{000}`, owner `required` field re-declared optional | nothing | **`autonumber-references-optional-field` warning** |
| an autonumber field the extension adds, format naming nothing | nothing | **`autonumber-references-unknown-field` error** |
| an owner autonumber re-declared `text` | `autonumber-references-unknown-field` error | nothing |
| list view over `xs_empty` (declares no field), extended (item 2) | `list-view-field-unknown` error | nothing |
| the same view over a declares-nothing object with a list `searchableFields` | `list-view-field-unknown` error | nothing |
| a form over a declares-nothing object, extended: the added field's entry | `form-field-unknown` warning | nothing (its other entries still warn, as on `main`) |
| a flow variable `partner` bound to an `xs_account` record (`{{ partner.nowhere }}`), where the extension adds a `partner` field to the trigger object | `flow-template-unknown-field` warning | nothing (the trigger scope now carries the served name, so `partner` is an ambiguous root, as a variable named after a declared trigger field is; a variable `acct` is still judged) |
| a form section naming `legacy`, an owner field declared in the legacy array `fields` shape, on an extended object | `form-field-unknown` warning | nothing (an extended object's names come off the served list, which reads both shapes; unextended, still `form-field-unknown` warning) |

## Verification

### Patch round (head `887e5623`)

The contract review (6670491743) asked for one code fix and two declarations. `887e5623`: `indexServedSearchTargets` reads names off the served objects with ties kept and blanks the tied metas afterwards, so an object whose every served field is tied (the owner declares only `title`, two packages re-declare it) still refuses `searchableFields: ['nowhere']` as `main` does; the changeset's Now / Not changed name the flow-variable root and the legacy array-shape moves (the last two rows of the table above). Same base `a8390207`, `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096`, heavy runs under `os-verify-lock`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: Test Files 195 passed (195), Tests 8216 passed (8216); `check:test-typecheck: OK`; VERDICT command-exit 0. The `[#30608]` describe: 42 passed; `object-graph.test.ts` 200 passed.
- Full dogfood battery: the closure build (VERDICT command-exit 0), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 420 passed, 3 skipped (423); Tests 3504 passed, 36 skipped (3540).
- `npx eslint --no-inline-config` over the 2 `.ts` files the round changes: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` at `887e5623`: the same 57 commands as at `2818af5b`, each run as printed, all 57 exit 0 (the seven `dist/` from the first round still present). `dispatch-gates --ran` over `<command> :: exit <code>` lines: "57 derived, 57 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", a derived zero, exit 0. `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main --event EVENT` with this body as the `pull_request` payload: exit 0.

- form-layout `served = declared` → **1 failed** / 198 passed (the existence row).

Ties and declares-nothing guards, one leg each: page visualization tie guard off, notify / flow template / autonumber tie read as a definition, searchable tie stub dropped → **1 failed** each (that site's tie row); notify, public form, page visualization (skip 2 on the served object), searchable (declared `null` dropped) and autonumber declares-nothing guards off → **1 failed** each (that site's declares-nothing row). Two first attempts were refused by the tool (the replacement text already occurred in the file) and re-run with distinct replacements; both then went red.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The searchable index ruling.** The ruling zone kept a react page's `searchableFields` refusal on an extension field unless the code shows the runtime search reads extension fields there. It does: the ingress gate's `resolveQueryFields` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-query-validation.ts:341`) reads `registry.getObject(object)`, which resolves through `foldExtendersOntoDefinition` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:6476`), and the engine's search expansion reads the same schema. The seat re-read it on `main` and amended the file surface to `validate-react-page-props.ts` (6669203452); the PR #30533 pin is flipped in place.
- **`indexObjectSearchTargets` stays declared.** It is exported, the sort rule composes it (it hands it pre-served objects and reads its `null` off the declared ones), and out-of-repo callers read it; the served reading is a new function beside it.
- **Declares-nothing, two readings kept.** The notify, public form, page visualization, searchable, autonumber and list-view rules skipped an object that declares no field on `main` and still do, extended or not, as the write, readonly and sort rules do after #30471. The form-layout and flow template rules judged such an object against the empty set on `main` (every entry reported); they still do, with the extension's names now known. Moving them to a skip would be a further widening outside this card.
- **The public form rule now sees extension fields of `image` / `file` type** on an object that declares fields, which is where its new refusals come from; on `main` such a field was the form-layout rule's `form-field-unknown` warning.
- **Other `indexServedObjectGraph` callers (sister card, carrier: seat).** Measured in the patch round on built `dist/` (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint build` of each commit's `packages/lint/src`, every other workspace package at this head), `runAuthoringRules('validate', { normalized })` after `normalizeStackInput`, union and per-package legs identical: `xs_empty` declares `fields: {}`, an extension adds `region`, a record page's `record:highlights` binds `['region', 'nowhere']` and a dataset's dimensions name `nowhere` and `region`.
  - `validate-dataset-references` (an `indexServedObjectGraph` caller): extended → `dataset-field-unknown` error, `dimension field "nowhere" is not a field on object "xs_empty".`; unextended → nothing (the declared `null` skip). The same on `887e5623`, on `origin/main` `b77c160a` and on `2046d21b` (`482e089a^`, before PR #30533): the extended object is judged on the extension's fields alone, so the gap predates #30533.
  - `validate-page-field-bindings` (reads `objectsAsServed` directly): extended → `page-field-unknown` warning, `field "nowhere" is not a field on object "xs_empty" — the component silently skips it, so it never renders.`; unextended → the same warning for `region` and for `nowhere`. The same on all three commits: this rule has no declares-nothing skip at all, so it judges such an object against the empty set extended or not (the form-layout reading), and the extension only takes `region` out of the report.
- **Visualization ties are per object, not per binding** (should-fix 1, not adopted; the seat's ACCEPT records why).
- **`rule-explanations.ts`** is not changed: none of the moved ids' explanations states a declared-only reading.
- **The runtime publish gates** (a `view` write for form layout and public form, an `object` write for autonumber) hand the rules a snapshot; this PR measured the CLI legs only.
